RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: unknown; these facts don’t support a defensible 0–100 estimate

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your longer experience is relevant, but doesn’t automatically outweigh her digital expertise or other selection criteria. The announcement alone cannot establish who was better qualified.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and the applicable recruitment and review procedures. Two weeks’ silence warrants a reminder, not an inference of discrimination.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments or inconsistent treatment. If you’re considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines promptly; don’t assume awaiting feedback pauses them.
